objects.description: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has used `ipconfig/all` and web beacons sent via email to gather network configuration information.(Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021)(Citation: Proofpoint TA427 April 2024) [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) has also identified Host IP addresses leveraging the WMI class `Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration`.(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025)
objects.description_fa: [Kimsuky](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0094) از «ipconfig/all» و نشانگرهای وب ارسال شده از طریق ایمیل برای جمع‌آوری اطلاعات پیکربندی شبکه استفاده کرده است. کلاس WMI «Win32_NetworkAdapterConfiguration».(Citation: Securonix Kimsuky February 2025) (Citation: Talos Kimsuky Nov 2021) (Citation: Proofpoint TA427 April 2024)
